name: app-health-research-dot-matrix-stats-slide
title: Health Research Dot-Matrix Stats
whatItIs: A grey slide titled User Resources with three columns of dot-grid graphics in blue, purple and black filling toward 86%, 78% and 64%, source labels, a rounded lab photo and a 69% micro bar chart.
whatItMeans: Dot grids turn percentages into countable units and colour-code the sources, making numbers easy to grasp.
techniques: Dot matrix as a percentage fill visual
One colour per data source with a coloured rule beside the caption
Big light numerals under each grid
Rounded photo beside a stat for human context
bestFor: Data storytelling with a light touch

vocabulary.definition: A grid of dots where filled dots represent a proportion.
A label naming where a statistic came from.
A column tied to one data source by colour.
